Point meanings

A quick guide to the points in your account.

PointMeaningPhase 1 use
PPVPersonal Point ValuePPV from sale price and agreed commission, saved with the order; auto activation up to Gold.
MIO PointsSeparate member currency wallet1 MIO Point is USD-referenced at $1; transfers, wallet activity and package activation.
BVBonus ValueBonus calculation base; 1 BV = $1.
DP / GPDirect / Generation PointsStored with package rules.
BP / BRPBinary / Binary Reward PointsBP tracks binary volume. BRP is recorded; no BRP conversion is enabled.

Sell with us

Join Market is Online as a marketplace seller. Applications and product listings are reviewed before they go live.

Seller application

Use your real business and contact details.

The standard proposed commission is 20% of each product sale. The company sends final agreed terms for you to accept before approval.

New applicants register with a referral code first. Existing active accounts and package consumers use their recorded inviter automatically.

Your account is already registered. Your recorded inviter is used automatically; no referral code is needed here.
